name: @frontierjs/mesa-vite
description: Vite plugin for Mesa (.mesa and .md) files — transform, HMR, error overlay, scoped CSS

notes.markdown: To process .md files, compiler-md.js must be resolvable (same directory as compiler.js). compiler-md.js requires: unified, remark-parse, remark-gfm, remark-rehype, rehype-slug, rehype-stringify.
